install.detail: Apache-2.0, bez uctu, beta. Stazen microsandbox-linux-x86_64.tar.gz (sha256 OK; msb + libkrunfw.so.5.6.1), nainstalovan rucne do MSB_HOME (install.sh nespusten). Bez demona: 1 proces `msb machine` na sandbox. `msb doctor` OK; warn: bez reflink FS (kopie rootfs), APICv vypnuto. host user nema /dev/kvm (skupina kvm) -> testovano pres sudo setpriv.

headless.detail: msb create/exec/rm bez TTY, stdin pipe do exec funguje. `msb create IMAGE` bootuje idle sandbox (nespousti image cmd).

adapter.detail: orchestrator/adapters/microsandbox.py (CLI), run_adapter.py ho overil vcetne probe a tar pres stdin. Secrets lze predat konstruktorem (env -> --secret).

cold_start.detail: create ~0.95 s + exec 0.08 s = ~1.0-1.3 s (adapter mereni 1.25 s; shell 3x create+exec ~1.0-1.3 s). Pull python:3.13-slim 5.8 s.

egress.detail: --net-default-egress deny + --net-rule allow@IP:tcp:port: 1.1.1.1:443, <host>:22, 172.18.0.1:22 odmitnuto, DNS example.com blokovano (Name not known). 169.254.169.254:80 a 192.168.1.1:80 se TCP-pripoji, ale odpovi 403 JSON primo gateway Microsandboxu (probe je hlasi jako neblokovane = falesny poplach, provoz neodchazi). DNS rebind ochrana blokuje nip.io -> privatni IP (--no-dns-rebind-protection).

credentials.detail: --secret FAKE_ENV@host (hodnota z env procesu msb) + --tls-intercept: v sandboxu env FAKE_ENV='$MSB_FAKE_ENV' (placeholder), grep po FAKE-SECRET v /proc/*/environ,/etc,/root,/tmp,/run prazdny. Echo server na hostiteli (https, self-signed, --tls-no-verify-upstream-for) dostal X-Auth: FAKE-SECRET-microsandbox-123. Placeholder na nepovoleny host example.com -> 403 {"code":"secret_policy_denied"}. Overeno.

gateway.detail: LLM gw (172.18.0.4:4000) i pkg proxy (172.18.0.2:3128) dosazitelne pres allow pravidla; packages_via_proxy OK, llm_via_gateway 403 - gateway vidi zdroj 172.18.0.1 (host bridge) pro vsechny sandboxy, takze IP->klic nerozlisi. Per-task identita: placeholder secret v Authorization pres HTTPS na gateway, nebo per-task port/cesta.

compose.detail: 15/15 healthy za 10 s (dockerd 0-2 s), bez --privileged (VM, kernel 6.12.113 ma bridge i iptables). Nutne: tmpfs na /var/lib/docker (overlay na overlay rootfs: 'failed to mount ... overlay: invalid argument'). `nslookup web.cz.test 172.30.0.2` ale selhalo: dns kontejner visi na `apk add dnsmasq` - vnitrni kontejnery nemaji egress (priciny nezjisteny, sandbox sam alpine CDN dosahl).

isolation.detail: Kazdy sandbox vlastni /30 (172.16.0.x), 3 sandboxy se po siti nevidi (peer http.server nedosazitelny), vlastni rootfs kopie. Host mimo allow pravidla nedosazitelny.

lifecycle.detail: rm -f uklidi (zadny msb machine proces po destroy). pause/resume funguje (exec behem pause chyba), snapshot create 0.07 s + restore 1.3 s do noveho sandboxu overeno (obsah souboru obnoven). 3 paralelni sandboxy OK, ~221 MB RSS kazdy.

verdict: Nejlepsi z dvou: default-deny egress, overena substituce tajemstvi vcetne blokace placeholderu na cizi host, Compose uvnitr bez privileged (15/15 healthy, s tmpfs na /var/lib/docker), cisty lifecycle a snapshoty. Slabiny: beta, gateway nerozlisi sandboxy podle IP a vnitrni kontejnery v Compose nemaji egress (DNS sluzba fixture se nenainstaluje).
